segments.text: Hello and welcome to another episode. Another? I think another's right. Another. Another episode. Not an episode of F**kface. We recorded one. Texas got snow on it. Apparently it's mayhem. Nobody has power. Nothing works. The episode was unable to be edited.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So I am here today to just let you know that the episode will come. It's not going to be out today, sadly. But I do have power, since I do not live in Texas. So I figured I should record something, so we at least have something here.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And I thought a lot about, like, where do I want to go with this, because I want to provide some content as well as an update.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And, uh, I thought, I have one F**kface story that I haven't shared. Nobody knows this. It's really, it's, it's almost like it's easier to say in this format, because I don't know what it would be like to tell Geoff and Gavin this directly.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That'd be really odd. But, uh, Andrew Panton isn't my real name. Andrew Panton is a made-up name. I used to, so I was a Rooster Teeth fan. I was a huge fan when I was, like, 13, maybe?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Before I met anybody. And my old gamer tag used to be ADSAC. And I built this really embarrassing map in Halo 3, in Forge. And it was just, like, everybody's names with gravity hammers and spawn points. It was, I'm cringing thinking about it and talking about it in this moment.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And it was just so embarrassing. And then, just through happenstance, I, I met Geoff and, and people and Gavin. And so then I freaked out, because this map, I couldn't figure out how to remove it from me.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And it said it was created by my gamer tag. So I panicked, and I changed my gamer tag to Andrew Panton. Andrew is the name of one of my uncles. And Panton is the last name of somebody I went to school with, as in, like, grade five.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Um, my real name is Raymond Somer. And I know that's fucking, this is a weird thing. But, I, like, I didn't, I didn't expect to become, you know, involved in the community to the extent I was, or become friends with anyone.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So I've been stuck as Andrew Panton for 13 years? Anyway, I don't really know what to say beyond that.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Um, but, uh, you can find me at Raymond Somer on Twitter. I have a Twitter account. There was a time where I kind of stepped away from doing any Rooster Teeth stuff, and I made an account in around 2014.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Uh, but then I came back, and I never really used it, so I think, I think I'll probably tweet, so.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: If you check Raymond Somer on Twitter, there's probably going to be a tweet there now.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Anyway, uh, sorry the episode couldn't come out. Have a fantastic day.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Anyway, and, uh, I'm sure it'll be out relatively soon? I don't know, just depends when power comes back.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Thank you for listening, and, uh, enjoy whenever the episode comes out, hopefully soon.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
